name: Driving Test Simulator
summary:
Master the art of driving! Enjoy 50+ handcrafted levels with 9 vehicles and realistic car physics. No traffic — just pure driving skills. Unlock cars, test your skills in mini-games, or just drive casually without any worries!


OTHER FEATURES
• Elaborated game controls that include both manual and automatic gearbox.

• Multiple Cars to choose from.

• Realistic Car physics and ambient sounds

• Complete challenges to gain experience

• Both left-hand drive and right-hand drive are supported
